scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@ibkr-terminal/gateway && npm run build --workspace=@ibkr-terminal/mcp && npm run build --workspace=@ibkr-terminal/terminal
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.test: npm run test:e2e:guards && npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:release: npm run check && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:e2e
scripts.desktop:prepare: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@ibkr-terminal/terminal && npm run bundle:runtime --workspace=@ibkr-terminal/desktop
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run desktop:prepare && npm run dev --workspace=@ibkr-terminal/desktop
scripts.desktop:build: npm run desktop:prepare && npm run build --workspace=@ibkr-terminal/desktop
scripts.test:e2e:desktop: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@ibkr-terminal/terminal && playwright test --config=playwright.desktop.config.ts
scripts.typecheck:source: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@ibkr-terminal/gateway && npm run typecheck --workspace=@ibkr-terminal/mcp && tsx scripts/typecheck-source.ts
scripts.check:source: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck:source && npm test
scripts.build:shared: npm run build --workspace=@ibkr-terminal/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@ibkr-terminal/service-runtime
